overall: The AG found the Fall River City Council violated the Open Meeting Law on both complaints: councilors secured support from a quorum outside a meeting, and counsel responded to a complaint before the council reviewed it.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged councilors deliberated outside a noticed meeting by gathering co-sponsor support for a proposed committee resolution before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: This process of securing support constituted deliberation between or among a quorum of the nine-member Council.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the council did not follow proper procedure in responding to an earlier Open Meeting Law complaint, as counsel responded before the council reviewed it.
allegations.key_passage: As the Council is required to review the complaint prior to authorizing legal counsel to respond, we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, publicly disclose at a meeting all e-mails between Councilors and/or the Council secretary concerning the proposed resolution.
remedy_passage: Within 30 (thirty) days of receipt of this letter, we order the Council to publicly disclose at a meeting all e-mails between Councilors and/or the Council secretary concerning the proposed resolution discussed herein.
